items.title: 21.11 Global climate and energy transfer from the Sun (Sooraj se energy ka aana aur duniya ka climate) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of global climate and energy transfer from the Sun (PDF 179-181).

blocks.text: Sooraj se milne wali energy duniya ke climate mein tabdeeliyan lane mein aham kirdar ada karti hai. Yahan hum mukhtasar dekhenge ke Sooraj ki energy zameen par kaise distribute hoti hai (phailti hai), aur equator aur poles ke darmiyan barabar garmi na hone (uneven heating) se atmosphere (hawa) mein kaise tabdeeliyan aati hain.
1. Earth's energy budget (zameen ka energy hisaab)

blocks.title: Earth's energy budget
blocks.text: Zameen ka energy budget zameen ki absorb ki hui Sooraj ki energy aur zameen ki wapas space mein radiate ki hui (bheji hui) energy ke darmiyan balance (barabari) hai.

Yeh batata hai ke Sooraj ki kitni energy zameen tak aati hai aur us mein se kitni reflection (lautne) aur emission (bahar nikalne) se wapas space mein chali jati hai. Jab zameen thandi hoti hai to surface par zyada ice aur snow (barf) hoti hai. Barf chamakdar hai aur bohat si dhoop wapas space mein reflect kar deti hai, jis se zameen aur thandi ho jati hai. Lekin jab zameen garam hoti hai to barf pighalne lagti hai. Is se neeche ki dark (gehre rang ki) zameen aur samandar khul jate hain, jo zyada dhoop absorb karte aur kam reflect karte hain; nateeja: zameen aur garam hoti hai. Aane aur jane wali energy ke isi balance ko zameen ka energy budget kehte hain, aur yeh zameen ka temperature steady (aik jaisa) rakhne mein aham hai. Fig. 21.12 zameen ke energy budget ka diagram hai. Is mein dikhaya gaya hai ke dhoop zameen ki surface aur atmosphere tak kaise pohanchti hai. Sooraj se aane wali energy, zameen se infrared (garmi ki) radiation ki shakal mein jane wali energy ke barabar hoti hai. Jab tak yeh balance qaim rahe, zameen ka temperature waqt ke saath aik jaisa rehta hai. Lekin greenhouse gases (jaise carbon dioxide aur methane) infrared radiation ko trap kar leti hain (phansa leti hain) aur space mein jane nahi deti. Is wajah se zameen garam ho rahi hai; is masle ko global warming kehte hain.

blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Zameen tak aane wali Sooraj ki energy ka sirf taqreeban 70% zameen absorb karti hai; baqi badal, barf aur desert (registan) ki surfaces wapas space mein reflect kar dete hain. Is budget mein sirf 1% ka imbalance (barabari ka bigarna) bhi duniya ke temperature mein bari tabdeeli la sakta hai.

blocks.alt: EARTH'S ENERGY BUDGET. Dhoop seedhi zameen ki surface tak aati hai, aur aik shaakh badal tak (Absorption of Solar Radiation by Atmosphere). Surface se: Convection and Conduction, Evaporation aur Latent Heat, space aur atmosphere ki taraf infrared. Atmosphere se: space aur zameen ki taraf infrared. Labels: Energy Gain by Atmosphere, Energy Loss from Atmosphere, Energy Loss aur Energy Gain at Earth's Surface, khali boxes ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.12: zameen ke energy budget ka diagram (kitab ki Figure 21.12 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen hissa batata hai ke surface energy kaise khoti hai (convection aur conduction, evaporation se latent heat, aur infrared), aur daen hissa ke surface energy kaise pati hai (dhoop, aur atmosphere se wapas aane wali infrared). Khali boxes kitab ne is liye chhore hain ke un mein energy ki amount likhi ja sake. Jab absorb ki hui dhoop space mein jane wali infrared ke barabar ho to temperature steady rehta hai; greenhouse gases zyada infrared wapas zameen ki taraf bhejein to zameen garam hoti hai.
2. Energy imbalance between the poles and equator (poles aur equator ke darmiyan energy ka farq)

Zameen ka climate system basically (asal mein) is baat se banta hai ke Sooraj ki energy us ki surface par barabar nahi phailti. Equator par dhoop seedhi aur tez parti hai; wahan garam hawa oopar uth kar low-pressure (kam dabao wale) areas banati hai. Poles par dhoop tirchi aur kamzor parti hai; wahan thandi hawa neeche baithti hai aur high-pressure (zyada dabao wale) areas bante hain. Energy ka yeh imbalance duniya bhar ki atmospheric circulation (hawa ka ghoomna) chalata hai aur hawa ke patterns banata hai: equator ke qareeb trade winds, mid-latitudes (beech wali latitudes) mein westerlies, aur poles ke qareeb polar easterlies. Yeh hawayein ocean currents ke saath mil kar duniya bhar mein garmi dobara phailati hain. Lekin insanon ki chhori hui greenhouse gases is natural balance ko bigar rahi hain, jis se global warming barh rahi hai aur mausam ke patterns badal rahe hain. Figure 21.13 zameen ka yeh energy imbalance dikhata hai: equator ko seedhi dhoop milti hai aur poles ko tirchi (oblique, angle par), jis se garmi barabar nahi hoti.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf Sooraj se parallel Sun's rays aik jhuki hui zameen par aati hain jis ke gird patli atmosphere hai. Beech wali ray par 'Sunlight Strikes Most Directly', oopar neeche wali par 'Low Angle of Incoming Sunlight'. Latitude lines: Arctic Circle, 60 degree N, 30 degree N, Tropic of Cancer, Equator, Tropic of Capricorn, 30 degree S, 60 degree S, Antarctic Circle; North Pole aur South Pole.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.13: poles aur equator ke darmiyan energy imbalance (kitab ki Figure 21.13 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Equator ke qareeb dhoop seedhi parti hai, is liye utni hi roshni chhote area par girti hai aur zyada garmi deti hai. Poles ke qareeb roshni tirchi (low angle) aati hai aur bare area par phail jati hai. Kaali lines 30 aur 60 degree latitude hain; safed dashed lines Tropic of Cancer/Capricorn (23.5 degree) aur Arctic/Antarctic Circle (66.5 degree) hain. Kitab do do labels aik saath likhti hai (maslan '30°N' aur 'Tropic of Cancer'), lekin yeh do alag lines hain.

blocks.prompt: Equator ko poles se har square metre par zyada Sooraj ki energy kyun milti hai?
blocks.explanation: Equator par dhoop taqreeban seedhi parti hai, is liye roshni chhote area par jama hoti hai. Poles par kam angle se parti hai, is liye wahi roshni kaheen bare area par phail jati hai (aur zyada atmosphere se bhi guzarti hai).

items: Energy budget: absorb ki hui dhoop = space mein jane wali infrared; balance ho to temperature steady.
Barf dhoop reflect karti hai; pighalti barf se aur garmi; greenhouse gases infrared trap karti hain (global warming).
Equator garam, poles thande: is farq se hawa chalti hai (trade winds, westerlies, polar easterlies).
